intro: Same prompt, four AIs, and us. Entertainment only. Graded at the DraftKings line each side was asked.
prompt_note: Asked Wednesday Oct 21, 2026 on the DraftKings line, before the Westgate card was out. Top 5s are graded at flat 1 unit. NE @ CHI is final: NE 24, CHI 30, and CHI -3 covered. The other 13 games are pending.
score_source: ESPN NFL scoreboard (https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard?week=7&seasontype=2&dates=2026). Only games with status final are stored. Friday Oct 23, 2026: NE@CHI final (NE 24, CHI 30). The other Week 7 games are scheduled and not stored.

NE@CHI.reason: NE has ~3/4 of the tickets and money, yet Chicago moved from 1.5 to 3. Vrabel hinted three injured O-line starters likely sit Thursday.

PIT@NO.reason: Neutral field, hook past 3. NO is 8-2 ATS in its last 10 as a dog; PIT is 3-7 ATS in its last 10 after a straight-up win.

NYG@HOU.reason: Heavy money on the Giants, yet Houston opened 8.5 and kept climbing.

TB@CAR.reason: The line flipped 4.5 points off Bucs -1.5, mostly on Mayfield's thumb. Carolina is 3-7 ATS as a favorite since 2022.

IND@MIN.reason: Indy outgained Tennessee by 213 yards and lost on turnovers and special teams. Vikings games are 4-1 to the Under.

SF@ATL.reason: The 49ers fly east on a short week. Mike Evans (Achilles) and Deebo Samuel (hamstring) are out.

CLE@TEN.reason: Tennessee is 0-12 straight up and ATS after a win. Cleveland is 2nd in sacks.

CIN@BAL.reason: Lamar was limited Wednesday. The line opened Ravens -3.5, and the points hold value if he plays.

MIA@NYJ.reason: Off a bye and swept the Jets last year. The Jets' coach is 0-7 against the AFC East. Total 39.5.

DEN@ARI.reason: Denver is 4-11 ATS in its last 15 road games. The line dropped 3.5 toward Arizona.

GB@DET.reason: Green Bay won and covered three straight, and Josh Jacobs returns. Detroit is 1-3-1 ATS.

LAR@LV.reason: Vegas is 5-1 ATS. The Rams lost Davante Adams for 6-10 weeks, and Poona Ford.

KC@SEA.reason: 84% of the tickets are on KC, yet Seattle rose from 1.5 on a sharp/public split, with extra rest.

DAL@PHI.reason: Contrarian lean. The Dallas offense should not lay 4.5 on the road, even against Tanner McKee.

NE@CHI.reason: Chicago's offense is humming at home behind Caleb Williams, and the NE defense on a short week will struggle to get off the field.

PIT@NO.reason: A disruptive front seven rattles a mistake-prone NO passing attack on neutral ground.

NYG@HOU.reason: Double-digit spreads are historically inflated, and the Giants keep it within two scores.

TB@CAR.reason: Divisional familiarity and late-down efficiency, with live moneyline equity.

IND@MIN.reason: Minnesota's blitz packages create pressure against an Indy offense vulnerable to third-and-long sacks.

SF@ATL.reason: Coaching and efficiency edge in high-leverage situations.

CLE@TEN.reason: Short road favorite in a coin-flip. Home dog in an ugly, run-heavy slog.

CIN@BAL.reason: Points with Baltimore at home against a division rival is situational value.

MIA@NYJ.reason: Miami's speed on screens and misdirection tests a Jets linebacker corps prone to over-pursuit.

DEN@ARI.reason: Suffocating pass coverage against Arizona's boom-or-bust offense.

GB@DET.reason: Detroit's offensive line wins the line of scrimmage indoors.

LAR@LV.reason: Massive talent and schematic edge in the passing game against a reeling Raiders secondary.

KC@SEA.reason: Mahomes catching points in a standalone primetime window.

DAL@PHI.reason: Favorable matchup against Philadelphia's compromised offense.

PIT@NO.reason: Better talent and pass rush outweigh the Saints' extra days on site.

TB@CAR.reason: Better form and a home edge against a struggling Bucs team.

IND@MIN.reason: The undefeated Vikings' defense controls an inconsistent Colts offense.

SF@ATL.reason: Undefeated talent outweighs the road trip and the receiver injuries.

CLE@TEN.reason: Solid 4-2 start and defense against a weak 1-5 Titans team.

CIN@BAL.reason: The market prices the Bengals with Lamar limited and uncertain.

MIA@NYJ.reason: Winless, depleted Dolphins, with Achane out.

DEN@ARI.reason: Broncos are 4-2; the Cardinals are 2-4 and struggling.

GB@DET.reason: Home-field edge in a tight NFC North game.

LAR@LV.reason: The Rams are inconsistent (2-4). The Raiders can stay within the number at home.

KC@SEA.reason: The undefeated Chiefs are the better team getting points.

DAL@PHI.reason: Hurts' absence creates a structural edge.

PIT@NO.reason: More trustworthy side, though laying more than a FG in a neutral-site game adds risk.

NYG@HOU.reason: Substantial cushion; Houston needs to win comfortably.

TB@CAR.reason: Full field goal protection in a game that could stay close.

IND@MIN.reason: Half-point beyond a touchdown is valuable if Minnesota doesn't pull away.

SF@ATL.reason: Stronger overall profile, though road favorite limits confidence.

CIN@BAL.reason: Baltimore at home with points in a divisional game.

DEN@ARI.reason: Denver wins despite offensive limitations vs. a 2-4 Arizona.

DAL@PHI.reason: Points and home field in a rivalry game.
